messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable mobile-friendly 2D pixel-art RPG about Neopets fairies.

## Requirements
- User requested a finished game without clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them at completion.
- Support phone/tablet play with responsive layout and touch controls.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (viewport no wider than 1280px) for visual checks.

## Decisions
- Created an original cozy fairy adventure, “Petalbound: The Dewlight Quest,” set in Mosslight Meadow in Neopia.
